purpose: Test repeatability of the selected exploration-persistence signal and its safety cost on three fresh paired training seeds.
checkpoint_selection: First saved checkpoint at/above 50k, within one full 2560-slot rollout; retain exact live counts.
capacity_control: Same local inputs, full_std gSDE architecture, parameter count and complete initial policy tensors, including log_std.
learning_control: Each run is evaluated against its own saved zero-experience policy; paired initial behavior must be identical.
primary_contrast: For each metric: (trained - own initial) with twelve-decision resampling minus (trained - own initial) with every-decision resampling.
aggregation: Primary analysis includes only these three fresh seeds. Show each seed, mean and sample SD of own-initial learning and paired timing contrasts; report the original pilot separately.
resource_policy: One simulator worker, six sequential arms; existing SAC/PPO and GAE coordinators remain unchanged. Combined local simulator use stays below five workers.
limitations: The recipe was selected after observing a pilot. The original seed 51700 is reported separately and excluded from the primary three-seed aggregate.
Twenty reused development worlds measure training-seed repeatability, not unseen-scenario generalization.
Same source, action support, full initial tensors and gSDE weight std within each seed; only resampling frequency differs.
The timing intervention changes both temporal action correlation and the optimizer response through the fixed KL stopping rule.
Both heading and speed noise timing change; their separate contributions are not isolated.
100k live transitions per run is a screening budget, not a convergence claim.
The prior pilot failed the restricted-area criterion. This follow-up does not waive that failure or declare a safe/competitive system.
Fixed route guidance and static filtering remain present. Aircraft-conflict filtering remains off.
Reserved streams20301/20302 and the official stream42 remain untouched.
failure_behavior: Stop this coordinator on a failed check or incomplete budget, preserve every artifact, and do not restart automatically.
initial_control: Full initial policy tensors and conditional action distributions are identical; only subsequent noise resampling differs.

noise_scale_review.interpretation: Noise matrix std is not marginal action std; input-dependent noise varies with features. These descriptive values are on a different initial seed, not performance evidence.

selected_pilot.why_follow_up: A 16-point own-initial clean-completion gain with shorter flights, accompanied by a restricted-area cost. Check repeatability before treating this as a candidate.

promotion_rule: No automatic promotion. Apply the unchanged multi-metric screen to each fresh seed and the fresh-seed mean, report every failure and all physical metrics, and require further candidate selection before untouched scenarios.
optimizer_accounting: Report actual steps and full-budget fractions per arm and seed. The exploratory pilot revealed different adaptive KL stopping; do not describe a matched update-count experiment.
